interfaces: new FileManualAgentProvider(root: string, options?: { repositoryRoot?: string, pollIntervalMs?: number }) implements AgentProvider
packetPath(packetId: string): string; resultPath(packetId: string): string; readPacket(packetId: string): LocalAgentPacket
importResult(packetId: string, envelope: unknown): { result: LocalAgentResult, resultPath: string, reused: boolean }
LocalAgentPacket: ipt.local-agent-packet schemaVersion 1.0.0; identity, full contextPackage, toolPermissionPolicy, resultBinding, instructions
LocalAgentResult: ipt.local-agent-result schemaVersion 1.0.0; bound COMPLETED with AgentRunResult, CANCELLED with error.message, or ERROR with error.message and recoverable:false

behavioralConstraints: supports every neutral role: Developer, QA, Architect, UAT/Product, MergeController; support is transport capability, never role or merge authority
pollIntervalMs defaults to 250 and accepts integers 1..60000; optional timeoutMs accepts integers 1..2147483647 milliseconds; signal is never serialized
full contextPackage and toolPermissionPolicy are preserved; contextIdentity/inputIdentity are deterministic SHA-256 identities with canonical object-key order and significant array order
same logical task/role/revision/run/actor packet identity cannot be rebound to changed context or policy; waiting timeout/signal are not external work identity
packet IDs are 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; flat exchange paths are <packetId>.packet.json and <packetId>.result.json

lossless JSON only: plain objects/dense arrays, null/boolean/string, finite numbers except negative zero; no undefined/functions/bigint/symbols/cycles/accessors/hidden properties/non-plain objects/sparse or augmented arrays
complete transport data is bounded to 4 MiB UTF-8, depth 64 and 100000 JSON nodes; this concrete adapter limit does not change the neutral runner range
imports validate schema, all envelope binding fields, packet integrity and nested AgentRunResult identity/semantics before atomic publication; shape-only validity never overrides a mismatch
exact export/import retries reuse accepted records; conflicting result imports cannot overwrite the first accepted result; symlinked/non-regular, corrupt or tampered files fail closed
COMPLETED preserves PASS, FAIL and BLOCKED; semantic FAIL/BLOCKED requires nonPass reason/remediation and never becomes retryable infrastructure failure
imported CANCELLED throws CANCELLED recoverable:false; imported terminal ERROR requires recoverable:false and throws PROVIDER_ERROR recoverable:false

local wait timeout throws TIMEOUT recoverable:true and abort throws CANCELLED recoverable:false; neither creates a terminal result file; later valid imports may satisfy explicit same-identity waits only

invalid requests/context-policy conflicts throw INVALID_REQUEST nonrecoverable; malformed identity/import/tamper/conflict throws MALFORMED_RESULT nonrecoverable; filesystem failures use PROVIDER_ERROR
operator must enforce external tool/network policy and fresh independent role sessions; cancellation cannot force-stop desktop tools
adapter preserves supplied compiled context but does not authenticate its producer, recompile role context, verify claimed evidence, or execute any authoritative workflow gate
schema validation uses an adapter-local evaluator for the authored schema vocabulary; unsupported keywords fail closed rather than being silently ignored
invariants: exchange packets/results are unauthenticated transport metadata, never evidence or lifecycle authority
adapter writes no validation/review evidence, mutates no lifecycle/assignment state, submits no review, creates no PR and performs no merge
one logical packet has at most one accepted immutable result; an exact repeat is reuse rather than a new judgment
transport COMPLETED is distinct from semantic PASS; FAIL and BLOCKED remain reachable
binding hashes and actor strings do not prove authentication, independent review, honest evidence or sandbox enforcement
dependency direction remains concrete adapter to neutral provider port; no vendor SDK/credentials, desktop UI automation or fantasy-product coupling
examples: offline export of complete QA context, fixture envelope copying resultBinding, valid import and AgentRunner return preserve task/role/revision/run
local wait timeout leaves the packet pending; explicit same-identity resume consumes a later imported result
QA COMPLETED with FAIL returns findings/nonPass unchanged for the existing QA gate and rework rules
wrong revision/context binding fails before publication and cannot replace an accepted result
duplicate identical import returns reused:true; imported external ERROR is immutable and nonrecoverable
edgeCases: Developer result keeps invocation packet revision even if implementation changes HEAD; existing deterministic validation resolves actual current HEAD afterward
bare AgentRunResult, free-form prose or a schema-valid envelope with mismatched nested result is rejected
late import cannot revive an already cancelled/timed-out promise or automatically resume a stopped orchestration engine
same JSON object content with different key order is equivalent; array order changes content identity
stale pending packet discovery is not permission to start another external session; confirm active workflow identity
transport acceptance does not waive review gate rules such as unresolved blocking findings on PASS

expectations: neutral result shape and identity are preserved
local cancellation stops polling without claiming forced external termination
semantic non-PASS remains a result, imported terminal failures are nonrecoverable
acceptedRanges: AgentRunResult outcome PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED
requiredReachableRanges: pending TIMEOUT/CANCELLED and imported terminal CANCELLED/PROVIDER_ERROR

expectations: import acknowledgement cannot imply workflow approval
exact duplicate imports are reusable and conflicts fail closed
requiredReachableRanges: offline export/import/run without network or credentials
idempotent exact import and conflicting import rejection

expectations: existing injected AgentProvider option remains sufficient; orchestration domain never imports file adapter
stable engine stage identity survives pending timeout and same-key resume
persisted terminal external failure cannot consume automatic retry budget or be overwritten into success
acceptedRanges: typed recoverable wait TIMEOUT and nonrecoverable imported cancellation/error
requiredReachableRanges: unchanged semantic FAIL/BLOCKED for authoritative gate handling

expectations: whole role context/tool policy is available without conversation memory
fresh role sessions and requested tools/network are externally enforced
acceptedRanges: COMPLETED, CANCELLED or ERROR result envelope
requiredReachableRanges: honest cancellation/external-error reports without fabricated judgment
